author: Turkey Tom
description:
Over the years, plenty of YouTubers and streamers have failed and had their careers cut short. But one man refused his fate. He’s been restlessly targeted by trolls – or detractors, as he would put it – some of whom were outright demented and obsessive. He accidentally streamed himself throttling his turkey. He’s been copyright-striked, demonetized, had accounts of his terminated, he went bankrupt… and yet, he’s still standing. This man is none other than DarkSydePhil. In today's video, we see him deal with his followers - both those who love, and hate him. We see his beef with fellow streamer Low Tier God, his friendly interactions with Wings of Redemption, and how Asmongold almost gave him a second chance to 'redeem' himself. Unfortunately for Phil, it all fell apart within a few months - leaving him right back where he started, as one of the most hated Gamers on all of YouTube.
